findings.message: The contributor compares bytes and checks integrated, but never validates the shared ModuleResult schema or the exact ChangeIntegration integrated outcome contract. A schema-invalid or extra-output/downstream-claim result can still project approved integration facts.

Reference resolution uses Array.find and silently accepts duplicate loaded artifacts for the same reference. Every exact work-item, change-set, architecture, and contract reference must resolve exactly once.
The test checks merged disposition and replay equality but does not prove the receipt binds prior graph version, update digest, execution identity, resulting checkpoint, and zero duplicate changes.
